decision: All five settings had zero blind dual-mode hits on the five primary development pairs. The selected setting and width-32 early epsilon 0.05 tied at two oracle dual-mode hits among all seven development pairs. The selected setting retained one blind seven-pair hit versus zero for width 32, and used 4.02 versus 12.59 times the unpenalized width-4 H100 inference time. Width 32 had only a 0.008 higher mean minority enrichment on the blind development shortlist; this small difference did not justify its worse blind coverage and threefold cost.
